description: What the agent did well, as the app shows it on a clean conversation: the judge's reason it is clean and each strength with the quotes that show it. Give a conversation for one, or a run_number for every clean conversation of that run. Only clean conversations have strengths. For what holds across many runs, read a report's strengths with get_report.

conversation.description: One conversation, by the id get_run or list_problems shows.
conversation.title: Conversation

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

run_number.description: Every clean conversation of this run.
run_number.title: Run Number

name: get_strengths
